failure_sequence.evidence: Execution entered the if-not-admitted branch after all predicates were computed.
failure_sequence.reporting_root_cause: The actor loop rebound the collect() Path parameter named output to RecurrentActorOutput; the rejection branch then called output.with_name().

unrecoverable_after_process_exit: native flattened crash and outcome metrics
inference_basis: The same VG005 checkpoint in VG006 had crossing_margin_violation rates 0.421875, 0.4375, 0.4375, and 0.421875 for counts 5, 8, 11, and 12.
Native source sets crossing_margin_violation when an ordered gate plane is crossed above 0.50 m radial, even though the actual admitted aperture radius is 0.75 m.
VG008 incorrectly required this diagnostic quality margin to be zero while deliberately collecting the VG005 failure distribution.
admission_root_cause_diagnosis.interpretation: The zero crossing-margin predicate is suitable for a centered oracle or final policy screen, but contradicts DAgger collection of successful-yet-imperfect and failed student states. It should be recorded, not used as a dataset safety rejection.

two_failure_stop.first_failure: VG007 rejected at 60887 records below its 100000-record floor; its missing rejection metrics also prevented proof of all other predicates.
two_failure_stop.second_failure: VG008 passed the corrected volume/layout/phase/reach checks, entered the rejection branch because another predicate failed, then lost the predicate map to the output-name shadowing bug.
two_failure_stop.required_disposition: Stop before a third Stage-3 collection variation and request an explicit superseding decision after this diagnosis.

required_future_correction_if_authorized: Use a new tag and seed; never reuse VG007 or VG008 arrays for training.
Rename the actor result variable so rejection reporting cannot shadow the output Path.
Persist the complete predicate map before any exception.
Keep crash, out-of-order, action, wire-rate, thrust, finite-value, terminal-layout, phase, and exact-uniform-count gates.
Record crossing_margin_violation diagnostically but do not reject a DAgger failure-state corpus solely because a valid 0.50--0.75 m crossing occurred.
Retain at least 512 episodes and the 100000-record floor.
